asserts: Channel 0 of v1_branching_factor_16.tslod stores, at levels 1 and 2, the representative the rule names for every bucket — the third column of each level's values stream is the chosen sample's value and the third column of its positions stream that sample's time — and level 2's is chosen from the raw samples, not from level 1's representatives.
source: tools/_representative.py — the specification's rule in scalar Python; times by the exact rule in tools/_tslod_build.py; inputs constructed by tools/gen_set5_representative.py
contract: A stored representative is a sample two writers must agree on, because a reader draws it, and two files that disagree about it draw different pictures from identical data.
notes: v1_branching_factor_16.tslod is the one golden file whose channel is long enough for a level 2 of more than two buckets: 4,096 float32 samples at branching factor 16 give 256 buckets at level 1 and 16 at level 2, so fourteen level-2 buckets run the triangle over 256 raw samples each. `input` is the channel's samples exactly as its level-0 blocks hold them.

cases.name: level-1
cases.stored_as: values[:, 2] and positions[:, 2] of every block at this level, in block order
cases.note: level 1: 256 buckets of 16 raw samples. Of them, 194 would store a different sample under the bucket's max; 17 would store a different sample under a pass block by block

cases.name: level-2
cases.stored_as: values[:, 2] and positions[:, 2] of every block at this level, in block order
cases.note: level 2: 16 buckets of 256 raw samples. Of them, 12 would store a different sample under the bucket's max; 11 would store a different sample under a choice among level 1's representatives
